review_candidates.description_excerpt: Responsibilities Deliver Microsoft 365 and infrastructure projects of medium complexity, from discovery and design through implementation, validation and handover. Assess client environments, document the current state, and translate business requirements into practical, secure and scalable technical solutions. Design, implement and configure collaboration, messaging, identity and security solutions aligned to leading practices and client governance requirements. Perform post-implementation vali
eligibility_evidence: Proven project experience with: New Microsoft 365 tenant deployments and workload configuration Tenant-to-tenant migrations Email migrations to Exchange Online from on-premises, hybrid and third-party sources, including Google Workspace File server and SharePoint on-premises migrations to SharePoint
Ability to obtain a criminal record check and federal security clearance.

You will be rewarded with generous base pay, vacation time, 4 paid personal days, a group pension plan with 4% matching, voluntary savings products, bonus programs, flexible benefits, mental health resources, exclusive access to perks and discounts, professional development assistance, MNP Universit
